name: video_zoom
description: Crop/pan-zoom a completed video creation, center-anchored (free, no AI, runs locally via ffmpeg). `mode: static` applies a constant punch-in for the whole clip; `in` animates 1x -> zoomFactor across the clip (Ken Burns); `out` animates zoomFactor -> 1x. To inspect detail in a single moment instead, extract a frame and use `images_crop`. Returns a new queued video creation; the source is untouched.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

mode.description: static = constant center punch-in for the whole clip. in = animates 1x -> zoomFactor across the clip. out = animates zoomFactor -> 1x. Center-anchored only.
